#### [load_image.list](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) Function {#func.load_image.list}
\

Loads image data from the dataset files downloaded from [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/vaibhao/handwritten-characters) and stored under root directory specified by the [root_path] argument.

::: { #func.load_image.list.usage .sidebar }
##### [Usage](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-scripts/ds.train2trimmed_img.dat.R#L15)
\

```{r func@load_image.list.u, eval=FALSE}
  train.img_dat.list <- load_image.list(root_path = img.train_root.dir,
                                        fn.load_image.dat = load.img_trimmed,
                                        folder.list = NULL,
                                        char_files.max = NA,
                                        char_files.seed = NA,
                                        random_sample = FALSE)

```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
In the *code snippet* above, a pointer to the auxiliary function [load.img_trimmed](#func.load.img_trimmed) described below in *this Section* is used as the value of the argument [fn.load_image.dat](#func.load_image.list.args.fn.load_image.dat).
:::
:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.args .sidebar }
##### Arguments
\

::: { #func.load_image.list.args.root_path .sidebar }
- **root_path:** Path to the root directory where image files were downloaded.; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.fn.load_image.dat .sidebar }
- **fn.load_image.dat:** Pointer to a helper function that loads a particular image file; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.folder.list .sidebar }
- **folder.list:**  (Optional, *Character*, $NULL$ by default) ; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.char_files.max .sidebar }
- **char_files.max:**  (Optional, *Integer*, $NA$ by default) ; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.char_files.seed .sidebar }
- **char_files.seed:**  (Optional, *Integer*, $NA$ by default) ; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.random_sample .sidebar }
- **random_sample:**  (Optional, *Boolean*, $FALSE$ by default) ; 

:::
:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.details .sidebar }
##### Details
\

:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.value .sidebar }
##### Value
\

:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.code .sidebar }
##### Source Code
\

The source code of the [](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) function is shown below:
```{r func@load_image.list.s, eval=FALSE}
load_image.list <- function(root_path,
                            fn.load_image.dat,
                            folder.list = NULL, 
                            char_files.max = NA,
                            char_files.seed = NA,
                            random_sample = FALSE) {
  start <- put_start_date()
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Getting file path lists...")
  img.file_list <- img.file_path.get_list(root_path, 
                                          folder.list,
                                          char_files.max,
                                          char_files.seed,
                                          random_sample)
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
File path lists have been created. The output list structure:
%1", capture.output(str(img.file_list)))
  put_end_date(start)
  
  label_list <- as.factor(names(img.file_list))
  
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Loading image files...")
  
  img_list <- lapply(img.file_list, function(char.dir){
    put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Loading files from root directory:
%1...",char.dir$root_path)

    img_dat.ls <- map(char.dir$file_path.list, 
                  fn.load_image.dat)
    
    valid.idx <- sapply(img_dat.ls, function(img.dat){
      mx.bin <- img.dat[1,,]
      mode(mx.bin) <- "numeric"
      
      sum(mx.bin) > 0
    })
    
    ls <- list(img.list = img_dat.ls[valid.idx], 
               fpath.list = char.dir$file_path.list[valid.idx])
    
    stopifnot(length(ls$img.list) == length(ls$fpath.list))

    put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Completed Loading files from directory:
%1.",char.dir$root_path)
    put_end_date(start)
    ls
  })
  
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Image files have been loaded. The output list structure:
%1", capture.output(str(img_list)))
  
  list(label.list = label_list,
       img.list = img_list)
}

```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
The source code of the [](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L4) function is also available in the [Data processing functions](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) section of the [data.helper.functions.R](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) script on _GitHub_.
:::
:::

#### [load.img_trimmed](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) Function {#func.load.img_trimmed}
\


::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.usage .sidebar }
##### [Usage](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-scripts/ds.train2trimmed_img.dat.R#L15)
\

```{r func@load.img_trimmed.u, eval=FALSE}
  train.img_dat.list <- load_image.list(root_path = img.train_root.dir,
                                        fn.load_image.dat = load.img_trimmed,
                                        folder.list = NULL,
                                        char_files.max = NA,
                                        char_files.seed = NA,
                                        random_sample = FALSE)
```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
In the *code snippet* above, a pointer to *this function* is passed in the [fn.load_image.dat](#func.load_image.list.args.fn.load_image.dat) argument to the [load_image.list](#func.load_image.list) function described above in *this Section*.

:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.args .sidebar }
##### Arguments
\

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.args.file_path .sidebar }
- **file_path:** Path to the image file to load. 

:::
:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.details .sidebar }
##### Details
\


::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
This is an auxiliary function, the pointer to which is passed in the [fn.load_image.dat](#func.load_image.list.args.fn.load_image.dat) argument to the [load_image.list](#func.load_image.list) function, as shown above in the [Usage](#func.load.img_trimmed.usage) section of *this Description*.
:::
:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.value .sidebar }
##### Value
\

:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.code .sidebar }
##### Source Code
\

The source code of the [](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) function is shown below:
```{r func@load.img_trimmed.s, eval=FALSE}
load.img_trimmed <- function(file_path) {
  img <- magick::image_read(file_path)
  # plot(img)
  
  img.trimmed <- as.matrix(c(0))
  max(img.trimmed)
  
  img.mx <- magick_img2matrix(img)
  
  if (max(img.mx) > 0) {
    img.trimmed <- image_trim(img)
  }
  
  magick::image_data(img)
}
```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
The source code of the [](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L4) function is also available in the [Data processing functions](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) section of the [data.helper.functions.R](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) script on _GitHub_.
:::
